$comment: Plain-English notes per model registry family, for the model sheet (modelSheet.ts). Written 2026-10-20 from the registry snapshot of that day (gpt-6-1-terra added 2026-10-26 from launch-day Artificial Analysis and OpenAI figures); each claim's benchmark is in `basis`. Families: every family runnable on the owner's machine plus the 40 current families with the highest Intelligence Index. Scores refresh with each snapshot; these words do not, so re-check them when a family's numbers move.
